Response List Machines Assets Machines Get

post.description:
Expects an .xlsx with a header row: plant_code, line_number (optional),
name, hostname (optional), device_model (optional), notes (optional).
Every machine is created as machine_type=VISUAL_INSPECTION, status=active.
Plants/lines must already exist (create them via /admin first) — this
endpoint doesn't create them.

schema.title: Response List Qr Tokens Qr Machines  Machine Id  Tokens Get

get.description:
Public, no auth — this is what the frontend's /a/<token> route calls
right after a field user scans the sticker, to find out which machine
it's for before routing them into the chat/ticket flow.

post.description:
Called after the client has successfully PUT the file to the presigned
URL — persists the attachment row so the rest of the app can find it.
